Callout.Name: Suspicious Scrapyard Load
Callout.Message: Scrap yard reporting a vehicle arriving for crushing.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle matches a stolen report, driver on site.

Script.Line: It came in on a truck an hour ago. No paperwork with it.
I have not crushed it. It is still on the pad, look at it.
The man who brought it said he would be back with the papers.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has brought in a car that matches a stolen report and wants it gone by this afternoon.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
